primary_evidence.description: Full JSON response from Jura Trace's REST API verify endpoint (POST /api/v1/verify). Schema is distinctly Jura Trace's (camelCase keys, detectorsRun array, c2paManifest object, deepfakeResult, clipResult, etc.) — provably not c2patool output.

internal_qa_note: c2patool_selfqa.json contains an internal cross-check we ran with c2patool 0.26.47 for our own QA. The C2PA Conformance Programme reviewer is expected to run their own validator against jura_signed.{ext} — this file is included only for reproducibility.
